## Log

- 2026-01-13: Split status.rs (294 lines) into modular structure:
  - `status/mod.rs` - Public API exports
  - `status/transitions.rs` - Simple status transitions (approve, start)
  - `status/done.rs` - Complex done workflow with workspace handling
  - `status/jj.rs` - jj integration helpers (workspace detection, snapshot, describe)
- 2026-01-13: Verified current.json dead code already removed (no references in source)
- 2026-01-13: Ran clippy - no warnings found
- 2026-01-13: Fixed error handling consistency - standardized anyhow! macro imports across migrate.rs, event.rs, and update.rs
- 2026-01-13: Verified all dependencies in Cargo.toml are used (clap, serde, serde_yaml, serde_json, chrono, rand, uuid, whoami, glob, colored, dialoguer, anyhow, toml)
